description: In front of the hands on the green tablecloth are several piles of colorful plastic beads, a dark cup, and an orange beaded strand lying across the table. The left hand holds the end of the orange strand steady while the right hand moves in from the right to pick up a single orange bead, threads it onto the strand, then shifts right to set a small cluster of orange beads down before returning to add another bead to the strand.
